name: Jewel Aich
bio: One of the most legendary and iconic figures in Bangladeshi magic. Known for his timeless stage performances and exceptional long career, making him a household name in Bangladesh's magic community.
speciality: Stage magic, Grand illusions, Classic performances
notable_achievement: Legendary founder of modern magic in Bangladesh

name: Prince Harun
bio: Renowned professional magician particularly popular for his innovative stage shows and revolutionary illusions like the 'flying table' and 'flying ring'. Dedicated to magic since childhood, he continues to push boundaries.
notable_achievement: Pioneer of flying table and flying ring illusions

name: Rajib Basak (Jadukor)
bio: Popular commercial magician recognized for his engaging performances particularly focused on children's entertainment and social awareness campaigns. Known for bringing magic closer to common people.
speciality: Children's magic, Commercial performances, Social awareness
notable_achievement: Popular commercial magician for kids and social events

name: Magician Khan Showkat
bio: Highly experienced performer who began his magical career in 1985. Established the Modern Magic Academy in Dhaka, playing a crucial role in training and nurturing new generations of magicians in Bangladesh.
speciality: Professional magic, Magic training, Academy direction
notable_achievement: Founder of Modern Magic Academy, Dhaka

name: Anik & Treshah
bio: Recognized as Bangladesh's premier couple magic act. Known for high-energy shows with exceptional chemistry, specializing in children's birthday parties, corporate events, and creating unforgettable magical experiences.
speciality: Couple magic, Party entertainment, Corporate events
notable_achievement: Premier couple magic act in Bangladesh

name: Rajib Shahani
bio: Unique magician known for specialized magic performances with Rubik's Cubes. Holds international records as the top collector of Rubik's Cubes and combines this passion with innovative magical performances.
speciality: Rubik's Cube magic, Puzzle illusions, International record holder
notable_achievement: International Book of Records - Top Rubik's Cube Collector & Magician
